description: Lasa Supergenerics Limited engages in the manufacturing API bulk drugs products in India and internationally. It offers API products, such as fenbendazole, toldimphos sodium, cyromazine, albendazole, riclabendazole, rafoxanide, ornidazole, 2,6-diiodo-4-nitrophenol, ricobendazole, oxfendazole, closantel base, closantel sodium, nitroxynil, halquinol, and oxyclozanide; and Other API products. The company also provides animal feed ingredients; and reagents for therapeutic use. In addition, it exports its products. Lasa Supergenerics Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Ratnagiri, India.
